name: Smoke test: app launches to home camera screen
goal: Verify the app launches without crash and shows the main camera-based home screen.
expected_result: The home screen loads without crash or blank screen and shows the settings entry point, camera preview area, language direction, and initial guidance text.
success_criteria: The visible UI includes Model: General.
The visible UI includes en to es language direction.
The visible UI includes the initial tap-to-detect guidance.

ground_truth.rationale: The source-backed launch state exposes the settings button, camera region, language labels, and initial carousel guidance.
